data.sub: Uttarakhand board exam se pehle 1494 pad rikt hain

chat.say: Pehle sir ko toh dhoond ke lao beta.

data.asar: Exam hall mein ab YouTube hi sahara banega.
data.caption:
Board exam sar par aa chuke hain aur classroom mein sannata hai! 📚😳

📌 Uttarakhand mein Board exams se theek pehle badi dikkat samne aayi hai
📌 Ganit, Vigyan aur English jaise mukhya vishayon ke 1,494 pravakta pad khali pade hain
📌 Students bina subject teachers ke taiyari karne par majboor hain

Ab syllabus poora ho na ho, self-study ka level 100 karna padega! 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo exam se ek raat pehle One-Shot video dekh kar top marta hai! 👇
